name: Takachiho (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Takachiho town emblem in yellow: an outlined device of two triangles with a horizontal bar, like an hourglass.
history: Municipal flag of Takachiho, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 March 1951.

features.role: Takachiho town emblem — an outlined device of two triangles with a horizontal bar, like an hourglass
